title: ProBoy-MD
summary: Open-source Node.js WhatsApp Multi-Device bot built by Shahan Ali (PROBOY) on Baileys, with 224 verified command files, pairing-code auth, and role-gated dispatch.
description: ProBoy-MD is a modular Node.js WhatsApp Multi-Device automation bot built with @whiskeysockets/baileys (7.0.0-rc.9 declared) by Shahan Ali (PROBOY / proboy315).

At audited commit c05d3225, the repository holds 224 JavaScript command modules across eight physical folders (ai: 49, dev: 28, fun: 43, general: 26, group: 30, media: 12, textmaker: 19, utility: 17). Commands are loaded by utils/commandLoader.js and gated in handler.js across owner, sudo, moderator, group-admin, and bot-admin permission tiers.

Connection uses WhatsApp's phone-number pairing code flow (via proboy-md.gt.tc or terminal prompt) with per-session settings directories. Note that ProBoy-MD uses the unofficial Baileys library rather than the official Meta WhatsApp Business Platform API, and at commit c05d3225 the declared package.json start file index.js is absent in the repository tree.
features: Baileys Multi-Device WebSocket session handling with pairing-code authentication
224 verified JavaScript command modules with alias collision handling
Owner, sudo, moderator, group-admin, and bot-admin permission gates
Interactive button layer (gifted-btns), media utilities, and Gemini/AI proxy helpers
creator: Shahan Ali

title: ProBoy Encrypt & Decrypt
summary: Browser-native Web Crypto AES-256-GCM encryption suite with PBKDF2 key derivation, PNG LSB image steganography, and local encrypted history vault.
description: ProBoy Encrypt & Decrypt runs encryption and decryption completely inside your browser via the native Web Crypto API (crypto.subtle) using AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption, without uploading plaintext messages or passphrases to any server.
It also supports Least Significant Bit (LSB) PNG image steganography to embed cipher payloads inside PNG pixel data alongside a local browser history vault.

Security model & threat boundaries: All cryptographic operations run client-side and depend on browser trust and host device integrity (if a device is compromised or untrusted scripts are injected, browser memory cannot protect secrets). Steganography conceals payload presence inside PNGs rather than adding cryptographic strength on its own — always pair it with strong AES-256-GCM passphrases. This tool is a privacy utility, not a third-party security audit or certification.
features: Client-side AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption via Web Crypto API
PNG LSB image steganography payload embedding and extraction
Zero server-side payload or passphrase transmission
Local browser encrypted vault with inspectable threat assumptions
creator: Shahan Ali

title: ProBoy JS Obfuscator
summary: Client-side JavaScript code transformation utility for identifier mangling, string encoding, and local download without uploading source files.
description: ProBoy JS Obfuscator is a browser-based JavaScript transformation tool that renames identifiers, transforms literals, and formats compact output locally in the browser without uploading source files to an external backend.

Important engineering boundary: JavaScript obfuscation only raises casual reverse-engineering friction and reduces readability. It is NOT encryption, NOT access control, and NOT a security guarantee — never ship API keys, database credentials, or secret business logic in client-delivered JavaScript.
features: Configurable identifier mangling and literal encoding
Instant side-by-side preview, copy, and .js file export
Honest documentation distinguishing obfuscation from real security
creator: Shahan Ali
